findings.rootCause: The earlier closure route had no accepted authority for deferring the listed real-provider, Owner and Gate evidence.
findings.correction: Commit the exact accepted Amendment-002 and acceptance evidence, retain every deferred production boundary in a 17-row machine-readable register, and mutation-test the prohibition on relabeling engineering fixtures as real evidence.
findings.remainingAuthority: Deferred evidence remains production-blocking until the future RELEASE-V1-001 gates named by Amendment-002.

findings.rootCause: AnalyticsCalculationService persisted an hour-aligned period while MetricEngine reconstructed a second now-ending FactWindow, so the query and identity could describe different facts.
findings.correction: AnalyticsCalculationService now owns one aligned half-open FactWindow and passes the same object to activity discovery, every MetricEngine fact query, persistence, diagnosis and digest generation; point queries use the exclusive period end.

findings.rootCause: Contribution Profit required sales, unit cost and fees but conditionally skipped return loss, advertising and tax, conflating absence with zero.
findings.correction: Operational and Settled Contribution Profit now enumerate sales, cost, platform fees, return loss, advertising and the appropriate tax authority; any absent or currency-conflicted component produces a non-available value, while an explicit sourced zero remains available.

findings.rootCause: MINIMUM_PRICE contained a partial break-even formula, defaulted missing terms, omitted Required Profit and Safety Buffer, and could not become CANONICAL_CONFIRMED through the real calculator.
findings.correction: V0029 forward-versions definitions, introduces BREAK_EVEN_PRICE and explicit per-unit commercial inputs, and defines MINIMUM_PRICE as canonical currency-consistent break-even plus sourced Required Profit and Safety Buffer without defaults.

findings.rootCause: Guardrail subtracted a whole-window fee aggregate from a one-unit price and did not require return, advertising, tax, stock, freshness or currency evidence.
findings.correction: Guardrail now consumes only named per-unit components, checks Break-even and Minimum Price independently, requires every economics/safety/inventory assertion, validates source freshness and currency, and reports all blocking reasons deterministically.

findings.rootCause: ComputedMetric identity contained referenced inputs but omitted the asserted value/state/confidence/source time; DATA_COMPLETENESS also had no mapping or required-input identity.
findings.correction: The digest now includes normalized value, currency, ValueState, ConfidenceState, oldest source time and deterministic identity components. DATA_COMPLETENESS binds the effective mapping and each required-input state while MetricRepository retains append-only deduplication for equivalent reruns.

findings.rootCause: The designated operating test accepted a blocked Guardrail as an alternate success and later command assertions tolerated refusal; browser fixtures injected the metrics instead of composing the calculator.
findings.correction: OperatingFlowIT now records facts, runs the actual MetricEngine and persistence, evaluates diagnosis and actual Guardrail, approves, and creates a DB-authoritative command with no early-return branch or external write. A same-class defect that marked CLEAR diagnosis rows as blocking was fixed in DiagnosisRepository.
findings.sameClassDefect: currentFindings projected rule.blocks_execution even when finding.outcome was CLEAR; it now blocks only TRIGGERED findings.

findings.rootCause: The permitAll maintenance surface relied on deployment routing; its interceptor checked only mutations and never authenticated the actual socket peer.
findings.correction: AdminMetadataGuard rejects every method unless HttpServletRequest.remoteAddr resolves to loopback, ignores all forwarding headers, then retains the write switch and operator attribution as additional mutation controls.

findings.rootCause: Serving startup required issuer only and a blank audience validator returned success; Terraform and runtime bootstrap also accepted blank audience values.
findings.correction: Every non-local/non-CI environment now requires a bounded nonblank audience; the decoder fails closed if none is configured; staging, production, workload module and packaged bootstrap validate the same shape while local/CI exemptions remain explicit.

findings.rootCause: The infrastructure workflow ran but its stable infrastructure-validation context was absent from protected main's required status checks.
findings.correction: The repository owns an exact 12-context inventory and mutation validator, and live Ruleset 20734984 was updated in place with strictRequiredStatusChecksPolicy=true while preserving every other rule.

sameClassScans.scope: analytics calculation and every OperatingFactQuery call
sameClassScans.disposition: One FactWindow is constructed in AnalyticsCalculationService; MetricEngine performs no clock read or window reconstruction; unrelated operational clocks are not calculation identity.

sameClassScans.scope: ComputedMetric and persisted Guardrail evaluation identity
sameClassScans.disposition: Metric assertion state/value/currency/confidence/source-time/custom components and complete metric snapshots in guardrail digest are now bound; equivalent reruns remain deduplicated.

sameClassScans.scope: profit, fee/tax categorization, Minimum Price and Guardrail economics
sameClassScans.disposition: All monetary deductions require an available sourced component; only published zero amounts remain zero. Unrelated import progress counters and empty checkpoint ordinals are administrative cardinalities, not commercial facts.
Whole-window totals are converted by explicit completed-unit denominators into named per-unit metrics; Guardrail no longer consumes aggregate PLATFORM_FEES.
Required policy limits, mapping, diagnosis, all economics and safety metrics, stock, freshness, confidence, currency and standing authorization fail closed with stable reasons.
The designated actual-service test contains no early-return acceptance and requires a passing Guardrail, approval and command; synthetic browser fixtures remain only browser behavior evidence.
The one path-pattern interceptor covers every current maintenance controller and rejects non-loopback GET/HEAD/OPTIONS and mutations before handlers; server.forward-headers-strategy remains none.

sameClassScans.scope: IdentityProperties, IdentityConfigurationContract, Terraform and runtime bootstrap
sameClassScans.disposition: Serving issuer and audience are mandatory; audience has one 1..255 bounded identifier grammar. jwk-set-uri remains intentionally optional because issuer discovery is the approved alternative.
All 12 stable job contexts, including infrastructure-validation, are present in both the repository inventory and live strict required checks.

sameClassScans.disposition: Exactly 17 Amendment-002 rows retain OWNER_ACCEPTED_DEFERRED_TO_RELEASE_V1_001 and validators reject forbidden real-provider/production labels.
